requirement_groups.source_instruction: B.A. in Global Cultures & Emerging Technologies Gang Liu, Teaching Professor of Chinese Studies; Director of Undergraduate Studies https://www.cmu.edu/dietrich/lcal/ Global Cultures & Emerging Technologies (GCET) is an interdisciplinary undergraduate major that examines how culture and technology shape one another across global contexts. At a time when artificial intelligence, immersive media and digital platforms are rapidly transforming how people communicate, create and live, GCET asks essential questions: How do cultural values influence technological innovation? How do emerging technologies reshape languages, identities and societies? And how can technology be developed and used responsibly across cultural boundaries? Rooted in the humanities and deeply engaged with technological inquiry, GCET prepares students to understand — and help shape — the cultural dimensions of technological change. Students explore global cultures and languages while gaining literacy in emerging technologies, learning to evaluate their social impact, ethical implications and global reach. Major Requirements Curriculum: 108 units (minimum) I.
